content_of_post_to_comment: Americans out there: why is home-schooling such a big thing in the US? It’s practically unheard-of anywhere else, and mostly limited to kids with extreme special needs. EDIT: can you please all stop giving me your personal opinion on home-schooling, that's not the question I asked!
comment: The interesting divide may be less about homeschooling itself and more about trust: in the US it seems tied to questions of who gets authority over education, a tension many systems handle differently.
